title: 第1章 开局威胁皇后
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

汉初，栎阳城，故秦皇宫走廊上。

大汉帝国皇后吕雉没有了往日的威严和干练，此刻的她仪态尽失。

几乎是噙着眼泪，大步奔跑着，来到了汉太子盈的寝宫中。

不为别的，就在半个时辰前，大汉帝国的太子刘盈，竟然遭人投毒。

此刻已然气若悬丝，随时都会命赴黄泉。

吕雉扑在榻边上，看着儿子苍白的小脸，浑身上下止不住的发抖。

她痛苦的脸庞上，猛然闪过一抹令人毛骨悚然的凶厉！

“救不好盈儿，你们这些废物庸医，全部处死！”

此言一出，台阶下跪着的十多个医者，顿时就活生生吓得昏死了两个。

其余的医者，一个个更是惊恐的磕头，哀声求饶起来。

偌大的太子寝宫中，骤然哀声成片。

“吵死了……安静一会……”

却在这个时候，那气若悬丝的太子盈，忽然发出不满的抗议声来。

偌大的宫廷上下，骤然寂静无声。

所有的人都一脸狂喜的看着那榻上中毒了的太子盈，翻了一个身，找了一个舒服的睡姿，还伸手扯了扯被褥。

非常不雅的把被褥夹在胯下，迷迷糊糊的说了一句：“波多野……老婆爱你哟！”

吕皇后红唇轻微颤抖着，轻轻地唤了一声：“盈儿？”眼泪却断了线的珠子一样，吧嗒吧嗒的往下掉。

无人知道，这个嘴里喊着奇怪话语的太子盈，他体内的灵魂，却已经变成了一个两千年后熬夜爆肝上排位、却二十连跪，随后打算

不曾想，他竟然兴奋过度猝死。

阴差阳错的穿越到了太子盈身上。

“盈儿！”

吕雉又唤了一声。

太子盈很是不爽的睁开眼来，正要说话的瞬间，猛地看到了下边跪了黑压压一片的人。

再一看这房屋……不对，这应该是宫殿！

看着身边这个保养的非常不错的贵妇人……

刘盈猛然感到自己脑海深处有一抹熟悉的记忆浮现出来，他下意识的对着眼前这威严的贵妇人喊了一声：

“娘……”

刘盈内心一惊：“卧槽？我穿越了，我是汉太子刘盈？眼前这个人是我的母后？

根据刘盈身体留下来的记忆，他是叫娘的，没叫母后。汉初并无如此多的规矩。

只有叫刘邦的时候，才会叫父皇。

“盈儿……你……你好了！”

吕雉看着儿子呆呆傻傻的模样，鼻尖一酸，就把儿子揽入怀中去，再也忍不住，放声大哭了起来。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

In the early Han Dynasty, Yueyang City, in the corridor of the Qin Palace.

The Queen of the Han Empire, Lu Fei, no longer had the majesty and ability of the past, and her manners were completely lost at this moment.

Almost with tears in her eyes, she ran with great strides and arrived at the palace of Prince Ying of the Han Dynasty.

If nothing else, just half an hour ago, Liu Ying, the crown prince of the Han Empire, was poisoned.

At this moment, he was so angry that he would die at any moment.

Lu Zhi threw himself on the edge of the couch, looking at his son's pale face, and couldn't stop trembling all over his body.

A chilling ferocity suddenly flashed across her painful face!

"If you can't save Ying'er, you useless quack doctors will all be put to death!"

As soon as these words came out, two of the more than ten doctors kneeling at the steps were so frightened that they fainted to death.

The other doctors kowtowed in fear and begged for mercy.

The huge palace of the prince suddenly erupted in mourning.

"It's so noisy...be quiet for a while..."

But at this moment, the furious Prince Ying suddenly let out a dissatisfied protest.

The entire palace was suddenly silent.

Everyone looked at the poisoned Prince Ying on the couch with ecstasy, turned over, found a comfortable sleeping position, and stretched out his hand to pull the quilt.

He tucked the quilt under his crotch in a very indecent manner and said in a daze: "Hatano... my wife loves you!"

Queen Lu's red lips trembled slightly, and she called out softly: "Ying'er?" But her tears fell down like broken beads.

No one knows that the soul in this Prince Ying who shouted strange words has turned into a person who stayed up all night to get ranked two thousand years later, but knelt for twenty consecutive times, and then planned to

Unexpectedly, he died suddenly from excessive excitement.

By accident, he traveled to Prince Ying.

"Yinger!"

Lu Pheasant called out again.

Prince Ying opened his eyes very unhappily, and when he was about to speak, he suddenly saw a person kneeling below him in a dark mass.

Looking at this house again... No, this should be a palace!

Looking at this well-maintained lady next to me...

Liu Ying suddenly felt a familiar memory emerge from the depths of his mind. He subconsciously shouted to the majestic lady in front of him:

"Mother..."

Liu Ying was shocked: "What the hell? I traveled through time. I am Liu Ying, the crown prince of the Han Dynasty? Is this person in front of me my mother?"

According to the memory left by Liu Ying's body, he was called mother, not queen.In the early Han Dynasty, there were not so many rules.

Only when he is called Liu Bang will he be called Father.

"Ying'er... you... you're fine!"

Lu Pheasant looked at his son's stupid look, the tip of his nose felt sore, and he took his son into his arms. He couldn't help it anymore and burst into tears.
